run_gen_arm32_reg_tables: run the script to generate ARM32 register definition C header file with X macros
create_reg_arm32: create a Reg object representing an ARM32 register with name, encoding, and feature flags
build_reg_features: build a RegFeatures object with register attributes like IsScratch, IsPreserved, IsGPR, IsFP32
test_reg_aliases: test register alias relationships between ARM32 registers across GPR, FP32, FP64, and Vec128 classes
summarize_reg_classes: summarize the ARM32 register classes GPR, I64Pair, FP32, FP64, and Vec128 with their encoding tables
